title: Fixed Guarded-Rotor Inspection Drone
description: One original complete fixed aerial-inspection-robot appearance. A chamfered centre body joins four diagonal arms, each carrying a complete thick open rotor ring, low motor appearance and one continuous fixed two-lobed propeller. Each blade has genuine empty space to the surrounding ring. Two continuous ground skids with integral support posts hold the centre body. A short lower stem supports one complete open-bottom camera yoke and a compact camera with a genuinely recessed opaque lens. Twenty-four closed editable meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, front -Y. Every visible body, arm, ring, blade, skid and camera is newly authored; no old asset geometry imported or reconstructed. One whole model, no scene or separate part counts. This is not the old wheeled rover without wheels, an airplane with repeated propellers, or a shortened old long-lens camera. Static visual art only: no flight, thrust, aerodynamics, autonomy, inspection capability, imaging, navigation, radio, battery, control, powered motion, moving gimbal, payload, protection, operational clearance, manufacturing, installation, stability or safety claim. Guard describes a visual surrounding ring, not certified protection.
